scope: The [software-agent-step] log from the live Builder build showed the agent calling project_read_files repeatedly with no usable paths, getting the same generic PROJECT_READ_FAILED each time. When paths is missing, empty or malformed, read the project's listed files (at most 20) through the same authorized host instead of failing; explicit valid paths behave as before.

keep: Reads go through the same authorized host.readFiles and project root
extend: project_read_files tolerates a missing or malformed paths input
